title: Samuel LLM ’55, SJD ’59 and Judith Pisar Visiting Professor of Law
bio: Justice Abella was appointed to the Supreme Court of Canada in 2004. She is the first Jewish woman appointed to the Court. In 2025, she was appointed a Companion of the Order of Canada.
